title: TOPO-Bench: An Open-Source Topological Mapping Evaluation Framework with Quantifiable Perceptual Aliasing
abstract: arXiv:2510.04100v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Topological mapping offers a compact and robust representation for navigation, but progress in the field is hindered by the lack of standardized evaluation metrics, datasets, and protocols. Existing systems are assessed using different environments and criteria, preventing fair and reproducible comparisons. Moreover, a key challenge - perceptual aliasing - remains under-quantified, despite its strong influence on system performance. We address these gaps by (1) formalizing topological consistency as the fundamental property of topological maps and showing that localization accuracy provides an efficient and interpretable surrogate metric, and (2) proposing the first quantitative measure of dataset ambiguity to enable fair comparisons across environments. To support this protocol, we curate a diverse benchmark dataset with calibrated ambiguity levels, implement and release deep-learned baseline systems, and evaluate them alongsi

translated_title: TOPO-Bench：一个具有可量化感知混淆的开源拓扑地图评估框架
translated_abstract: 拓扑地图为导航提供了一种紧凑且鲁棒的表示方式，但该领域的进展受到缺乏标准化评估指标、数据集和评估协议的阻碍。现有系统在不同的环境和标准下进行评估，导致无法进行公平且可复现的比较。此外，一个关键挑战——感知混淆——尽管对系统性能有重大影响，却一直缺乏量化分析。我们通过以下方式填补这些空白：（1）将拓扑一致性形式化为拓扑地图的基本属性，并证明定位精度可作为一种高效且可解释的替代评估指标；（2）提出首个数据集歧义性的定量度量方法，以实现跨环境的公平比较。为支持该评估协议，我们整理了一个具有校准歧义级别的多样化基准数据集，实现并发布了深度学习基线系统，并对它们进行了评估。
tldr: TOPO-Bench 首次提出数据集歧义性的定量度量方法，并以拓扑一致性和定位精度为核心建立标准化评估协议，同时开源了带校准歧义级别的基准数据集与深度学习基线系统，实现了拓扑地图系统的公平、可复现比较。
en_tdlr: TOPO-Bench proposes the first quantitative measure of dataset ambiguity and establishes a standardized evaluation protocol based on topological consistency and localization accuracy, releasing an open-source benchmark dataset with calibrated ambiguity levels and deep-learned baseline systems for fair and reproducible topological mapping evaluation.
